このラジオ{局|きょく}の{周波数|しゅうはすう}は80.3メガヘルツです。
examples.english: This radio station's frequency is 80.3 megahertz.

examples.japanese: {高|たか}い{周波数|しゅうはすう}の{音|おと}は{年|とし}を{取|と}ると{聞|き}こえにくくなる。

examples.japanese: {電子|でんし}レンジは2.4ギガヘルツの{周波数|しゅうはすう}の{電磁波|でんじは}を{使|つか}って{食品|しょくひん}を{温|あたた}める。
examples.english: Microwave ovens use electromagnetic waves at a frequency of 2.4 gigahertz to heat food.

notes:
A technical term from physics referring to the number of cycles a wave completes per unit of time, measured in hertz (Hz). Commonly encountered in contexts related to radio, sound, electronics, and telecommunications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {周波数|しゅうはすう}{帯|たい}: frequency band
- {周波数|しゅうはすう}を{合|あ}わせる: to tune to a frequency
- {高|こう}{周波|しゅうは}: high frequency
- {低|てい}{周波|しゅうは}: low frequency
- {周波数|しゅうはすう}{変換|へんかん}: frequency conversion

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頻度|ひんど}: frequency — refers to how often something occurs, not wave cycles
- {振動数|しんどうすう}: vibration frequency — more specific to mechanical oscillations
- {波長|はちょう}: wavelength — the inverse concept, measuring distance between wave peaks
